messages:
maria-g: Quick idea — can we teach the deploy-bot a single `pin-and-note` command that does three things: pins the rollout, attaches a one-line release note, and auto-opens a rollback anchor? I'd use this for tiny hotfixes to avoid the manual checklist.

raj: +1. Example UX: `/deploy pin-and-note v2.3.1 --note "fix: NV routing bug" --change-window 30m` — creates pin, note, and a rollback draft with the commit sha.

alex_k: Love it. How do we avoid accidental pins? Maybe require `--confirm` for non-staging or add a short cooldown for prod pins.

jen_ops: Suggestion: default to dry-run unless `--confirm` provided. Bot should echo the three actions and show what will run. Also add `--who` to tag oncall.

maria-g: agreed. Minimal CLI prototype I sketched:
```
/deploy pin-and-note v2.3.1 \
  --note "fix NV routing" \
  --change-window 30m \
  --target prod \
  --confirm
```
Bot response:
> pinned rollout v2.3.1 to prod
> created release note: "fix NV routing"
> rollback draft: /rollback create --from v2.3.1 --to v2.3.0 --reason "regen"

raj: We should persist a small metadata blob in the release notes: deploy_bot_id, pinned_by, commit, window_end. That makes audits easier.

deploy-bot: @maria-g pinned v2.3.1 to prod (commit abc123) :white_check_mark:\nrelease note created: "fix NV routing"\nrollback draft created: rollback_2026_03_10_abc123

alex_k: Nice. One more: add `--slo-bypass` flag that attaches a short note for latency-sensitive fixes so paging rules don't escalate unnecessary alerts for the window.

jen_ops: Also add `--announcements` to auto-create a short Slack post in #product and #support with the note and change window.

maria-g: Implementation plan: 1) bot command handler + dry-run; 2) create release-note resource + small JSON metadata; 3) auto-generate rollback CLI snippet; 4) safeguards (cooldown, confirm, perms). I can PR the handler and template.

raj: If you're writing the PR, add unit tests for the three outputs and an integration test hitting the dry-run flow.

maria-g: I'll draft the PR today. tagging @jen_ops for ops policy review before we flip confirm default for prod.

jen_ops: I'll review. If not blocking, prefer default dry-run on prod. :eyes: 

alex_k: If you want a quick helper, here's a tiny bash wrapper to call the bot via the CLI gateway (for local dev):
```
#!/bin/bash
./deploy-cli pin-and-note "$1" --note "$2" --change-window "$3" --target "$4" ${5:---dry-run}
```

maria-g: perfect — thanks. I'll include that snippet in the PR description.

deploy-bot: Noted. I will surface a confirmation dialog for prod by default and support `--confirm` to bypass. Rollout metadata schema: {"pinned_by":"maria-g","commit":"abc123","window":"30m"}

raj: small nits: use ISO timestamps in metadata, and store the change-window end time explicitly.

maria-g: acknowledged. PR up later today, will post link here when ready. :rocket:
